title: Venetian glassblowing
summary: Gather glass on the pipe, blow it to the shape of a goblet and dip the bowl in cobalt and amethyst, with white threads wound into the wall.
howToPlay: Match the shape in the frame.
Drag across each row to set its width.
Tap the bands to dip them in coloured glass.
rules: The goblet has a wide foot, a thin stem with a knop and a flared bowl.
Shape counts for 70 of the 100 points and the colour of the bands for 30.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40. Watch and learn blows a whole goblet for you.
heritageNote: Venetian glassblowers, above all those of Murano, learned to gather molten glass on an iron pipe, blow it and shape it with simple tools. Fine goblets are often decorated with threads of white glass wound into the wall and rims of gold.
